library(gt)
library(dplyr)

# Create a display table with the `exibble` dataset
gt_tbl <- gt(exibble)

# Now, show the gt table
gt_tbl

gtcars_mini <- gtcars |> select(mfr, model, year, hp, trq, msrp) |> slice_tail(n = 10) gt(gtcars_mini, rowname_col = "model", groupname_col = "mfr") |> tab_spanner(label = md("*Performance*"), columns = c(hp, trq)) |> tab_header( title = html("Data listing from gtcars"), subtitle = html("A small selection of great cars.") ) |> cols_label(year = "Year Produced", hp = "HP", trq = "Torque", msrp = "Price (USD)") |> fmt_integer(columns = c(year, hp, trq), use_seps = FALSE) |> fmt_currency(columns = msrp) |> tab_source_note(source_note = "Source: the gtcars dataset within the Great Tables package.")

airquality_mini <- airquality |> slice_head(n = 10) |> mutate(Year = 1973L) gt(airquality_mini) |> tab_header( title = "New York Air Quality Measurements", subtitle = "Daily measurements in New York City (May 1-10, 1973)" ) |> cols_label( Ozone = html("Ozone,
ppbV"), Solar.R = html("Solar R.,
cal/m2"), Wind = html("Wind,
mph"), Temp = html("Temp,
°F") ) |> tab_spanner(label = "Date", columns = c(Year, Month, Day)) |> tab_spanner(label = "Measurement", columns = c(Ozone, Solar.R, Wind, Temp)) |> cols_move_to_start(columns = c(Year, Month, Day))

exibble_smaller <- exibble |> select(date, time) |> slice_head(n = 4)

gt(exibble_smaller) |>
  fmt_date(columns = date, date_style = "wday_month_day_year") |>
  fmt_date(columns = date, rows = 3:4, date_style = "day_month_year", locale = "de-CH") |>
  fmt_time(columns = time, time_style = "h_m_s_p")

airquality_mini <- airquality |> slice_head(n = 5)

gt(airquality_mini) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Temp, rows = 2:3)
  )

exibble |>
  select(num, currency) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = num, decimals = 1) |>
  fmt_currency(columns = currency) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "lightcyan"),
      cell_text(weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(columns = num)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#F9E3D6"),
      cell_text(style = "italic")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(columns = currency)
  )

gt(airquality_mini) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = starts_with("Te"),
      rows = Temp > 70
    )
  )
